system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Only each skill's `name` and `description` sit in the system prompt, so a large skill library costs almost nothing until it's used.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt includes a runtime-loaded skill list; quick mode trims the toolset and keeps skills out. The assembly code was not inspected.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: it pipes the output through the worker model for a tight summary before the main agent sees it. This keeps the context window manageable on long tasks.
context_compaction.note: Per-tool-call worker summarization (result_mode) compresses individual observations. There is no evidence of whole-history summarization.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The agent works by screenshotting the screen, reading the element map, and clicking or typing by element label.
observation_format.note: Screenshots and the element map come from computer_use, which is macOS-only. fetch_page returns markdown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The agent can return many tool calls in a single reply. By default they all run in parallel.
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from the tool-call terminology and the use of OpenRouter. The parser was not inspected.

tool_count.note: The README lists roughly 45 tools, but the exact default schema count, including platform and key-gated tools, cannot be verified.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit_file` applies an ordered array of exact `old_text`/`new_text` replacements.
edit_primitive.note: write_file is assumed to perform a whole-file write.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The agent discovers and uses all tools exposed by connected MCP servers.
tool_schema_source.note: The source of the built-in tool schemas was not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connects to your existing MCP servers via `~/.dtt/mcp.json`

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each turn, the agent decides which tools to call, reads the results, and decides what to do next.

planning_granularity.note: Quick mode has no plan bookkeeping.

multi_agent_topology.note: The default toolset includes delegate to a worker model and browser_agent handoff. --orchestrator mode runs multiple agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the agent can hand off the session to a dedicated Notte browser agent via `browser_agent`.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: an OTP code, a preference, or confirmation before a destructive action.
human_in_loop.note: Confirmation is initiated by the model through request_user_input; live input can steer the run. Evidence for a harness-enforced gate is weak.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Plans its work and tracks progress

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Loads custom skills from `~/.dtt/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` (Claude Code convention).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: If you interrupt a run or hit the loop limit, resume with `--resume <thread-id>`.

self_verification.evidence_quote: asks a stronger one for a second opinion when it's stuck
self_verification.note: The oracle is invoked by the model rather than enforced by the harness, so this is the closest available value.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: It keeps going until the task is done or it hits the loop or cost limit.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: It keeps going until the task is done or it hits the loop or cost limit.
termination_condition.note: The loop cap defaults to 200 turns. --max-cost is opt-in.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Farms out grunt work to a cheaper model, and asks a stronger one for a second opinion when it's stuck
cost_controls.note: Also supported: --max-cost and Anthropic prompt caching.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Dothething (DTT) is a local AI agent.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Reads and edits files, runs shell commands, makes HTTP requests
filesystem_access.note: Coded relative to the host. --cwd sets the working directory.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Reads and edits files, runs shell commands, makes HTTP requests

tracing.evidence_quote: Every session saves to `~/.dtt/threads/` with a timestamped ID.

eval_hooks.note: The file tree contains no evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: API keys, tokens, and secrets are masked before writing to disk.

target_domain.evidence_quote: It handles research, data extraction, browser automation, file editing, and code execution.

open_source.evidence_quote: BSD 3-Clause. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the full text.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Any of the four roles can be swapped for a different OpenRouter model with `--model`

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: an autonomous AI agent: you describe the thing, it does the thing.

pinned_version.note: No tagged release in evidence; pinned to main commit given in snapshot header.
